steps.title: Define Modern Calculator App Requirements
steps.description: Outline the core features for the Modern Calculator app, including basic arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division), clear functionality, and a user-friendly interface.

steps.title: Set Up Android Project Structure
steps.description: Initialize the Android project with the generated app name 'Modern Calculator' and package name 'com.moderncalculator.app'. This involves creating the necessary directories and initial build files.

steps.title: Configure Project Dependencies and SDK Versions
steps.description: Update the app/build.gradle file to set the correct compileSdkVersion (34), targetSdkVersion (34), minSdkVersion (21), and ensure compatibility with Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2. Define the application ID as 'com.moderncalculator.app'.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest
steps.description: Create the AndroidManifest.xml file, specifying the package name 'com.moderncalculator.app', setting the application label to 'Modern Calculator', and declaring the MainActivity with the appropriate icon references (@drawable/icon).

steps.title: Design the Calculator User Interface
steps.description: Develop the layout for activity_main.xml to create a visually appealing calculator interface. This will include a TextView for the display and a grid of buttons for numbers (0-9), operators (+, -, *, /), clear (C), and equals (=).

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Structure
steps.description: Create the MainActivity.java file within the 'com.moderncalculator.app' package. This file will be the main entry point for the application and will manage the UI and logic.

steps.title: Initialize UI Elements in MainActivity
steps.description: In MainActivity.java, find and reference all the TextView (for display) and Button elements defined in activity_main.xml. Attach an OnClickListener to each button.

steps.title: Implement Number Button Logic
steps.description: Add logic to MainActivity.java so that pressing number buttons appends the digit to the current display string, ensuring correct handling of initial zeros and decimal points.

steps.title: Implement Operator Button Logic
steps.description: Develop the functionality for operator buttons (+, -, *, /). When an operator is pressed, the current number is stored, and the selected operation is set for the next calculation.

steps.title: Implement Clear (C) Button Logic
steps.description: Add the clear button functionality to reset the calculator's state, clearing the display, current number, previous number, and pending operation.

steps.title: Implement Equals (=) Button Logic
steps.description: Code the equals button logic to trigger the final calculation based on the stored numbers and pending operation, displaying the result on the screen.

steps.title: Add Core Calculation Functionality
steps.description: Create a private method in MainActivity.java to perform the actual arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) based on the current and previous values and the selected operator.

steps.title: Refine UI and UX for a Modern Look
steps.description: Review activity_main.xml for a clean and modern design. Ensure button sizes, spacing, and text styles contribute to a beautiful user experience.

steps.title: Final Code Review and Debugging
steps.description: Perform a final review of all code, including MainActivity.java and activity_main.xml, to identify and fix any potential bugs or logical errors, ensuring robust functionality.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Execute the Gradle build command to compile the 'Modern Calculator' application into an APK.
